# routeros_mpls_traffic_eng_path (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_mpls_traffic_eng_path" "path" {
  name                 = "example"
  affinity_exclude     = "1"
  affinity_include_all = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tunnel path, referenced by the `primary_path` and `secondary_paths` properties of the traffic engineering tunnels.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `affinity_exclude` (String) Do not use an interface if its `resource_class` matches any of the bits specified here. Written as a decimal number or as a `0x`-prefixed hexadecimal number.
- `affinity_include_all` (String) Use an interface only if its `resource_class` matches all of the bits specified here. Written as a decimal number or as a `0x`-prefixed hexadecimal number.
- `affinity_include_any` (String) Use an interface if its `resource_class` matches any of the bits specified here. Written as a decimal number or as a `0x`-prefixed hexadecimal number.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `holding_priority` (Number) Priority used to decide whether the session set up over this path can be preempted by another session. `0` is the highest priority.
- `hops` (List of String) Explicit route of the path. Every element is an IPv4/IPv6 address optionally followed by `/strict` or `/loose`, for example `10.3.1.1/strict`. The order is significant.
- `record_route` (Boolean) Whether the sender node asks to record the actual route the LSP traverses, which is also used for the loop detection.
- `reoptimize_interval` (String) Interval after which the path is re-optimized.
- `setup_priority` (Number) Priority used to decide whether the session set up over this path can preempt another session. `0` is the highest priority.
- `use_cspf` (Boolean) Whether to use the CSPF (Constrained Shortest Path First) calculation to complete the path instead of following the explicit route only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/mpls/traffic-eng/path get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_mpls_traffic_eng_path.path "*1"
```
